reproduces.note: The 2026-10-13 bundle was produced by a comparison harness outside this repository. This directory restates that harness's adapters, mappings and package lock so the run can be repeated from committed inputs.

axe.configuration: axe.run with runOnly tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa, wcag22a, wcag22aa; violations are findings, incomplete is review

pa11y-htmlcs.configuration: runners [htmlcs], standard WCAG2AA, errors are findings, warnings are review

ibm.configuration: ruleArchive versioned, policies [WCAG_2_2], VIOLATION/FAIL are findings, VIOLATION/POTENTIAL and VIOLATION/MANUAL are review
ibm.note: accessibility-checker resolves its rules at run time: it reads archives.json from the `@next` dist-tag of accessibility-checker-engine (4.0.29 on 2026-10-13 and on 2026-11-02) and, for ruleArchive `versioned` and checker 4.0.34, loads engine 4.0.27 (archive 13July2026). The 2026-10-13 run fetched both from a CDN. Here both come from the package lock and are served on 127.0.0.1.

lighthouse.configuration: onlyCategories [accessibility]; binary audits with score 0 are findings; criteria from the axe rule of the same id

alfa.configuration: every rule in @siteimprove/alfa-rules against one Puppeteer page snapshot; failed outcomes are findings, cantTell is review

qualweb.configuration: ACT rules, WCAG techniques and best practices modules; assertions with failed > 0 are findings, warnings are review

nu-html-checker.configuration: rendered DOM posted to a local service; errors are findings; specialized markup lane, never criterion recall

cognium.access: private: the runtime is not redistributed; this directory holds the subject declaration, the command and the sanitizing importer
cognium.subject: cognium/latest-browser-served-subject.yaml
cognium.note: A pack version is not unique on its own: workspace pack sources changed between commits that carried a11y/html 1.2.1. The commit is the pin.

published_environment.direct_tools: darwin/arm64, Node.js v25.9.0, Chromium 149.0.7827.55 (Playwright 1.61.1 browser build 1228)
